# HelloEcom

> HelloEcom is a UK & EU-built eCommerce operator working with brands worldwide. One accountable team runs Amazon and marketplace management, Shopify, Magento and WordPress stores, Google, Meta and Pinterest Ads, SEO (including AEO and GEO) and digital marketing training. Offices in Birmingham (UK) and Gurugram (India). Contact: connect@helloecom.net

## Services
- [Amazon services](https://helloecom.net/amazon-services.html): Seller Central advertising, listing creation and optimisation, A+ content, account health and reporting.
- [Marketplaces](https://helloecom.net/marketplaces.html): Listing and management on eBay, Walmart, Etsy, Bol.com, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra and other marketplaces.
- [Shopify services](https://helloecom.net/shopify-services.html): Shopify design, development, migration and optimisation.
- [Magento](https://helloecom.net/magento.html): Magento store build, upgrades, extensions and day-to-day management.
- [WordPress design & development](https://helloecom.net/wordpress-services.html): WordPress and WooCommerce websites.
- [Google Ads](https://helloecom.net/google-ads.html): Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns, Merchant Center feed management.
- [Meta & Pinterest Ads](https://helloecom.net/social-ads.html): Paid social prospecting, retargeting and catalogue ads.
- [SEO services](https://helloecom.net/seo-services.html): Technical, on-page and agentic SEO, plus Answer Engine (AEO) and Generative Engine (GEO) optimisation.
- [Digital Marketing Training](https://helloecom.net/digital-marketing-training.html): Training in Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and advanced SEO.
